Package domain

package domain
  • Class
    Description
    AIController
    Controller of a player moved by the machine (Template Method): AIController.nextActions(domain.Player, domain.Match) is the fixed part (it decides again only after its reaction time) and AIController.decide(domain.Player, domain.Match) is what each profile does.
    ArcadeMode
    Arcade: a match between the two chosen characters, by time or by goals.
    Ball
    The real ball of a match.
    BallSkin
    A ball of the store catalog.
    BlueAuraShot
    Blue Aura, the shot of South Korea: straight and horizontal, at high speed.
    BracketMatch
    A match of the tournament bracket: which two teams play it, in which round, and how it ended.
    ClumsyAI
    Machine that plays badly: sometimes it goes for the ball and sometimes it does anything.
    DefensiveAI
    Machine that guards its goal: it only goes for the ball when the ball is in its half.
    DOPOSoccer
    Facade of the domain: the only class the interface talks to (Facade pattern).
    DOPOSoccerException
    Error of the game: an invalid choice, an action that cannot be done at that moment, or an option that is still under construction.
    Effect
    Something that changes what a player can do for some seconds.
    ElectrocutedEffect
    Electrocuted, from Lightning (Cameroon): for 3 seconds the rival cannot jump and runs at 50 % of its speed.
    Entity
    Anything that moves on the field: the players, the ball and the fake balls.
    ExpertAI
    Machine that plays well: it reacts faster, clears the ball when it is in its half, attacks when it is closer to the ball than the rival and goes back to guard its goal when the rival has the ball in the other half.
    FakeBall
    Fake ball of the Illusion shot.
    GameCharacter
    A character: a country (a team) with a power shot.
    GameMode
    Game mode: how many matches are played.
    Goal
    Goal area of one side.
    GoalsMatch
    Match by goals: the first side to reach the target wins, with no time limit.
    HumanController
    Controller of a person: it remembers which action keys are pressed.
    IllusionEffect
    Confusion, from Illusion (United States): for 2.5 seconds the rival does not know which ball is the real one.
    IllusionShot
    Illusion, the shot of the United States: the ball splits into 8 identical balls; 7 are fake and disappear after IllusionShot.DURATION seconds.
    LightningShot
    Lightning, the shot of Cameroon: straight and covered with electricity.
    Log
    Registry of the unexpected errors of the game.
    Match
    A match between two players.
    MatchType
    Rule that says when a match ends and who wins (Strategy pattern).
    OffensiveAI
    Machine that always goes for the ball to attack.
    PhysicsEngine
    Adapter of the physics library dyn4j (Adapter pattern).
    Player
    A player on the field: a character controlled by a person or by the machine, with the stats of its profile.
    PlayerController
    Who decides the actions of a player: a person with the keyboard or the machine (Strategy pattern).
    PlayerProfile
    Progress of a player: its points, its stats and what it bought in the store.
    PowerShot
    The unique power shot of a character (Strategy pattern).
    PushEffect
    Push, from Blue Aura (South Korea): the rival is thrown towards its own goal and cannot control itself for 1.5 seconds.
    ScoreBoard
    Goals of each side during a match.
    Settings
    Settings of the game: volume of the music and of the sound effects, from 0 to 100.
    Stadium
    The field in one of the three resolutions, with a goal at each side.
    Stats
    Stats of a player, from 1 to 10.
    StunEffect
    Stunned: the life of the player reached 0 because of the rival's kicks or power shots.
    SurvivalMatch
    Survival: each player starts with 3 balls and loses one for each goal received; the match ends when a player has no balls left.
    TimeMatch
    Match by time: it lasts the chosen minutes and the side with more goals wins.
    TornadoShot
    Tornado, the shot of Nigeria: a whirlwind close to the ground that bounces fast.
    TournamentMode
    Tournament of 8 teams against the machine: quarterfinals, semifinal and final.
    UnconsciousEffect
    Unconscious, from Tornado (Nigeria): the rival is thrown up in the air and for 3 seconds cannot move, jump or kick.
    Wallet
    Points of a player: they are won playing and spent in the store.
